sections.title: F. Extended Comparison with State-of-the-Art Methods

abstract_sentences.text: Real-world multimodal learning is often hindered by missing modalities.

While Incomplete Multimodal Learning (IML) has gained traction, existing methods typically rely on the unrealistic assumption of full-modal availability during training to provide reconstruction supervision or cross-modal priors.
This paper tackles the more challenging setting of IML under training-time incomplete observations, which precludes reliance on a “God’s eye view” of complete data.
We propose LIMSSR (LLM-Driven Incomplete Multimodal Sequence-to-Score Reasoning), a framework that reformulates this challenge as a conditional sequence reasoning task.

evidence.anchor: reformulates this challenge as a conditional sequence reasoning task

abstract_sentences.text: LIMSSR leverages the semantic reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models via Prompt-Guided Context-Aware Modality Imputation and Multi-dimensional Representation Fusion to infer latent semantics from available contexts without direct reconstruction.

evidence.anchor: infer latent semantics from available contexts without direct reconstruction

abstract_sentences.text: To mitigate hallucinations, we introduce a Mask-Aware Dual-Path Aggregation to dynamically calibrate inference uncertainty.

Extensive experiments on three Action Quality Assessment datasets demonstrate that LIMSSR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines without relying on complete training data, establishing a new paradigm for data-efficient multimodal learning.

introduction_moves.move: context；多模态互补性与 sensor failure、privacy shielding、data corruption 造成的 Reality Gap，要求 IML 适应任意可用模态子集。上一段未留下问题；本段建立现实场景；下一段转向既有范式。
problem + failure_of_prior_work；把 IML 方法分为 reconstruction-based 与 distillation/prior-based，并指出两者共同依赖 full-modal training。回答“缺失模态的既有监督从何而来”；留下“完整训练数据不现实”的缺口。
missing_insight；训练期完整模态缺席时，核心困难是缺少无 direct supervision 下完成缺失语义的 mechanism。为任务改写准备问题定义。

evidence.anchor: lack of a mechanism to “imagine” or complete missing semantics

introduction_moves.move: core_idea；给定 partial modalities 与 missingness mask，模型推断缺失 latent representations 并用于 downstream prediction，LLM 被定位为 reasoning engine。下一段解释 prompt 和 token。
method_preview；PCMI 组织 boundary/missing tokens，LMRF 用 fusion-token slots，MDA 在输出侧融合高层语义和低层模式。回答“核心洞见如何落地”；下一段引出 latent-space regularization。
method_preview + theory_preview；Consistency Learning 对齐 dual paths，Token-level Metric Regularization 防止 token collapse。回答“任务损失为何不够”；下一段进入 AQA 实验。
experimental_setup；将长期 AQA 作为高语义、长时依赖、需跨模态稳定性的测试床，列出 FS1000、Fis-V、RG。下一段进入 contribution list。
contribution_list；将 IMAQA 定义为 conditional sequence-to-score reasoning，并声明训练与测试阶段均允许缺失。
contribution_list；提出 LIMSSR，用 special tokens 引导 completion/fusion，并用 mask-aware aggregation 处理 reasoning uncertainty。
contribution_list；声称验证 LLM missing-information reasoning，并在三 benchmark 达到新 SOTA。

method_moves.move: setup_notation；定义标准 IML 的 D_full、全模态 X 与推理子集 X̃，并指出 L_rec/L_distill 的监督前提。
state_problem；定义 D_train={(X_i⊙m_i,m_i,y_i)}，说明 m_ij=0 同时意味着输入和重建/蒸馏 target 缺失。
instantiate_algorithm；把问题实例化为 RGB/audio/flow 的长期 AQA score regression。

evidence.anchor: video, audio, optical flow feature matrices

method_moves.move: summarize + define_component；用 Eq. (1)–(3) 把 Context Construction、LLM Latent Inference、Dual-Path Aggregation 串为 Fθ 映射。
define_component + explain_mechanism；用冻结 modality extractors 和 ϕ_m 投影异构序列到 D_LLM。
derive + give_intuition；PCMI 以 start/end tokens 和 T 次 missing embedding 建立等长 placeholder，并由 prompt 指定可用／缺失条件。
define_component + connect_to_prediction；LMRF 追加 K fusion tokens，抽取 H_fusion 并以 role weights 得到 z_main。
explain_mechanism + derive；MDA Path 1 由 mask-conditioned gate/residual 校准 semantic path，Path 2 对 hidden states 做 pooling/self-attention/gating。
connect_to_prediction；用 λ_syn 协同 H_sem(z̃_main) 与 H_dyn(z_aux) 输出 ŷ。
derive + connect_to_experiment；定义 task/consistency/token-regularization objective 与 λ 权重，为 Table 3 的 loss ablation 提供对象。

final_judgment.single_storyline: 训练期完整模态不可用时，LIMSSR 将 IML 写成由 missingness mask 条件化的 sequence-to-score reasoning：PCMI 把缺失变成 tokenized latent variable，LMRF 把多维语义放入 fusion slots，MDA 以 semantic path 与 cross-modal pattern path 协同解码。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 D_train 形式化、三阶段 Figure 2、PCMI/LMRF/MDA 核心公式、三 benchmark 的 incomplete/complete 平均结果、Table 3 组件与损失消融，以及 RG 的 ρ/MSE 差异。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 数据集分割、指标公式、预提取 feature 来源、epoch/归一化/架构、backbone/K/LoRA/prompt 消融、六 seed SD、参数/FLOPs、细分表和 latent/t-SNE/attention 诊断移入 Appendix A–F；正文可读但细分验证需要跳转。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 2 把数据流、mask、冻结边界和损失放在同一图；Table 1 用六种 mask 加 full 构成对照；Table 3 用累加与删除同时检验增益和必要性；Eq. (1)–(17) 依组件顺序贴合段落。
final_judgment.largest_gap: SOTA 与 robustness 主要依靠单值 ρ/MSE、均值和 seed SD，缺少显著性／效应不确定性与自然缺失机制；hallucination calibration、all-missing extreme case、跨域泛化和端到端部署未被独立验证。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 对训练数据缺失的多模态序列任务，先把 missingness 写入训练分布和输入接口，再为每个组件安排加入／删除及跨 mask 结果，最后用 representation-level diagnostic 检验推断表示的目标对应关系。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则要求可观测 missingness mask、可对齐的跨模态表示和下游指标；缺失机制未知、超出训练 mask 或没有 diagnostic target 时，本文的 token imputation 和 dual-path 优势不能直接外推。
